errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis are ordered by increasing company size, not alphabetically. For example, 'Над 5000 служителя' (Over 5000 employees) comes after 'От 1000 до 5000 служителя' (From 1000 to 5000 employees), but 'Н' comes before 'О' in the Bulgarian alphabet.

The description incorrectly states that the bars are 'unordered elements'. The bars are clearly ordered from left to right based on increasing company size. This also contradicts the first part of the same sentence which correctly states they are ordered by company size.
